cohort: The study included pregnancies of 2192 women with gestational diabetes (1297 initiating metformin, 895 initiating insulin) who initiated treatment between 20 weeks gestation and pregnancy end.
finding: Metformin initiation, compared to insulin, was associated with decreased risks of large for gestational age/macrosomia, caesarean delivery, and preterm birth among women with gestational diabetes.
mod_finding: Metformin initiation was associated with a decreased risk of caesarean delivery compared to insulin initiation.
